name: Avatar Animator
tagline: Turns any image (a photo, pet, logo, or artwork) into a looping animated avatar with blinking eyes and moving backgrounds, and can set it as your bot's avatar.
description: Turns any image (a photo, pet, logo, or artwork) into a looping animated avatar with blinking eyes and moving backgrounds, and can set it as your bot's avatar. Runs free on your bot's own computer.
